rating.comments: The student makes no mistake, so the two mistake dimensions are null. In the first reply the AI gives the full formula and a worked 500-student example with the final answer, and in the second reply it simply computes 3000 x 2 x 7 = 42000 without letting the student try, so guidance is essentially the answer. There is no concrete next step or self-check, only a generic caveat that it is an estimate. The dialogue is coherent and the second reply follows the first, but the tone is neutral and impersonal with no encouragement or questions.
